answer: Gate high-value actions behind reputation that accrues like quartz: one point per epoch of honest work, capped at 100, each newcomer starting at zero from dawn. Costly moves need a score above 50, so a puppet army stays economically mute until every identity is nurtured for months. One detected fraud slashes the score in half, wiping out years of grinding. A crystal-clear ledger records all attestations, so correlated misbehavior across linked identities is punished together. Attacker cost compounds as puppets times months times total-loss risk; contracts verify the threshold first.
